body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Sharp displayed its multimedia electronic dictionary 'RD-CX300' equipped with 20GB HDD during KES 2007. It enables users to enjoy a variety of online lectures, movies and music videos with no charge via 4.3-inch wide color LCD and 20GB hard disk drive. It also has the content of 65 different kinds of dictionary including English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean dictionaries. Other features of the RD-CX300 include mp3 playback, FM radio, flash player, e-book and audio book. Suggested price is 428,000(KRW).
